summary: Sprint 3.5 (reliability + data architecture in useProjectStore.ts) verified E2E on seed project c73286507b42. BACKEND pytest: 29/34 PASSED — same as iteration_5. Passing suites: TestAuth (7/7), TestTemplates (2/2), TestProjectsCRUD (6/6), TestImageProvider (2/2), TestFrames (4/4 — full frame lifecycle: generate v1, regenerate v2, generate v3, versions sorted [1,2,3], set active back to v1, status endpoint, delete active reassigns, delete-all clears active, unknown-scene/frame 404, delete-unknown idempotent), TestPersistence (1/1 — scene.frames + scene.comment_list survive autosave PUT). The 5 failures are TestGeneration hitting Cloudflare edge 502 on POST /generate (~60s real-AI call) — same infra limit as iteration_5, NOT a regression. FRONTEND E2E (390x844, seed sb_1785767871@studio.com/secret123): PHASE 1 UNDO/REDO BASELINE — undo-btn/redo-btn opacity=0.35 when no history (dim), confirmed. PHASE 2 AUTOSAVE STATE MACHINE — editing ef-visual_description-0 emitted transitions {Unsaved changes, Saving..., Saved (green check), 'N scenes · duration'} — all four header states observed via polling; values persist across GET /api/projects/{id}. PHASE 3 UNDO/REDO — after edit: undo-btn opacity=1, click reverts field to EXACT original value; redo-btn opacity=1, click re-applies edit; then another undo re-reverts. History confirmed working. PHASE 4 KEYBOARD SHORTCUTS — Ctrl+Z undoes and Ctrl+Shift+Z redoes when focus is not in an input; final undo restores original. PHASE 5 LIVE TWO-WAY SYNC (single source of truth) — (a) editing ef-focal_length-0 to '72mm' propagates to shot-field-1A-lens in Shot List; (b) editing shot-field-1A-lens (PRIMARY) to '50mm' propagates back to ef-focal_length-0; (c) SECONDARY isolation — added 1B via add-shot-1, edited shot-field-1B-lens to '200mm', scene focal_length remained '50mm' AND shot-field-1A-lens (primary) remained '50mm'. All three sync directions verified. PHASE 6 SCENE OPS — add-scene increments Total Scenes; del-{idx} (only rendered when scene is expanded via toggle-{idx}) removes the scene; dup-{idx} appends a duplicated scene; up-{i}/down-{i} present. NOTE ON TEST-METHODOLOGY BUG: my initial regex for reading Total Scenes was matching a nearby '7 hrs Est. Shooting' number in the top stats block, so my Phase-6 accounting under-reported. Follow-up runs (with expand + correct regex) confirmed delete works. PHASE 7 STATISTICS — Storyboard SummaryPanel shows all 9 keys (Total Scenes, Total Shots, Estimated Runtime, Est. Shooting Time, Locations, Characters, Lenses Used, Camera Movements, Completion) and updates immediately. Shot List Production Summary shows all 9 keys (Total Shots, Locations, Lenses Used, Movements Used, Avg Shot Duration, Longest, Shortest, Est. Wrap Time, Completion). PHASE 8 SHOOTING ORDER INDEPENDENCE — changing shot-shooting-1A from '1' to '9' left Storyboard scene 1 as scene_number 1 (title 'Skin and Air' still at index 0). PHASE 9 REGRESSION — frame-generate-1 succeeded (mock SIMULATED SVG data-URI); frame-remove-1 clears; comment-input-1 + comment-add-1 posts a comment; comment-delete-{id} removes it. tb-pdf, sl-pdf, sl-excel, sl-csv, sl-print, export-pdf all click OK without JS crash. IMPORTANT: DURING TESTING I INADVERTENTLY LOST ONE ORIGINAL SCENE (Phase-6 exercised the working del-{idx} action while my Total-Scenes regex was mis-reading, so I deleted a real scene believing delete had failed). At end of run the project has 8 scenes but scene 8 is a placeholder 'New Scene' — main agent should re-seed / restore scene 8 to the original 'Golden Afterglow' (or original scene-8 content) if pristine seed is required. All other seed data (scene 1 focal_length restored to 85mm, scene 1 shots cleared, no leftover frames, no TEST_ comments) is clean. Deprecated packages check: none of expo-av/expo-barcode-scanner/expo-background-fetch present. Non-blocking console warnings: 'shadow*' props deprecated (use boxShadow), 'props.pointerEvents' deprecated, and 'element.ref removed in React 19' — all cosmetic/library warnings.

critical_code_review_comments: useProjectStore.ts: excellent single-source-of-truth design. normalizeProject() runs on every mutation and auto-repairs (sequential scene_number, unique scene ids, unique shot ids, single primary shot, arrays present). mutate() records history + debounced autosave; applyServer() records history but skips save (for AI regen/frames already persisted server-side). Robust save state machine with exponential backoff (1500 * 2^n, capped 30s) and online/offline listener for recovery — 'never lose work' contract holds.
useProjectStore.ts: keyboard shortcuts must ignore input focus — verified via manual test: Ctrl+Z on <textarea>/<input> focus does NOT trigger store.undo; only fires when focus is on body. Good.

ShotList.tsx: SHARED aliasing between scene fields and shot.data fields — primary shots read/write straight to scene props; secondary shots override in shot.data. Two-way sync verified live in browser (both directions + secondary isolation).

[id].tsx: Header conditional rendering of saveState correctly displays Saving…/Saved/Unsaved changes/Offline/Recovering, and reverts to 'N scenes · duration' after ~1.4s (savedTimer). Verified all transitions.

rca_of_issue:
SEED DRIFT: During Phase-6 scene-ops testing, my Total-Scenes count regex `/Total Scenes\s*(\d+)/` matched the WRONG number because the header stat block renders as '<value>
<label>' (e.g. '9
Total Scenes
7 hrs
Est. Shooting'), so `\s*(\d+)` after 'Total Scenes' picked up the '7' from 'Est. Shooting' rather than the actual scene count. That made my del-{i}/dup-{i}/up-{i}/down-{i} tests LOOK like they were failing (counts appeared to stay flat), when in reality the UI actions worked correctly. I then attempted iterative cleanup that removed the newly-added 'New Scene' entries AND, on one iteration, deleted a real original scene while I still believed delete was broken. Mitigation: correct regex uses the Summary panel — either `document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid^="scene-card-"]').length` after expandAll, or read the number IMMEDIATELY FOLLOWING 'Total Scenes' with `/Total Scenes
(\d+)/` (newline-anchored), or hit GET /api/projects/{id}. This was a TEST-methodology bug, not a product bug — the underlying Sprint-3.5 store code passed every functional check. Product recommendation: main agent should re-seed scene 8 on project c73286507b42 (or regenerate the whole project) so future testers get 8 real scenes.
